title: Minimum Cost Tree From Leaf Values
goal: Build an ordered leaf tree with minimum total nonleaf cost.
strategy: Every interval can split between two adjacent leaves. Its root cost is the product of the two side maxima, plus the best costs for both smaller intervals.
